title: ConSiDERS-The-Human Evaluation Framework: Rethinking Human Evaluation for Generative Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and meta-analysis of human evaluation practices (e.g., analyzing 19 medical journal papers evaluating ChatGPT) to demonstrate how subjective rating scales like the Likert scale are vulnerable to human cognitive biases, such as the halo effect, processing fluency, and anchoring bias, which conflate language fluency with factual correctness.
